verdict.rationale: The evidence shows static parameter documentation, llms.txt text files and example JSON snippets, but nothing about an interactive 'try it' console or runnable examples inside the reference. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, so no spec-driven interactive reference is evidenced. Static docs are an adjacent feature and earn no credit for this story.
